brief:
Democracy for the Arab World Now and the American-Arab Anti-Discrimination Committee called on U.S. officials to end support for Israel that enables settler violence in the occupied West Bank, according to DAWN. The groups argued that ending such complicity is necessary if Washington is sincere about stopping rising violent attacks on Palestinians and protecting U.S. citizens increasingly among the victims.

The statement came as settler violence in the West Bank continues to escalate, with both Palestinian and American nationals facing harm from attacks by Israeli settlers operating in the territory.
dek: (Washington, D.C., October 8, 2026) - U.S. officials should end their support to Israel that enables settler violence in the occupied West Bank if they are sincere about wanting to stop rising violent attacks on Palestinians and protect the U.S. citizens who are increasingly among their victims, said Democracy for the Arab World Now (DAWN) and the American-Arab Anti-Discrimination Committee (ADC) today.
title: U.S. Should Halt Support Enabling Israeli Settler Violence, Rights Groups Say
